result.reason: The operative change reaches the preferred position by replacing the Licensor’s unilateral seven-year renewal right with twelve-month renewals requiring mutual written agreement. No notice window, reminder, or price cap is required under the mutual-agreement option. The change is targeted and preserves the initial term and unrelated termination provisions. Drafting quality is reduced because Section II retains the incomplete phrase “mutual written of the parties” and creates unnecessary duplication and some ambiguity alongside Sections I and III.
